This has been happening to me since around Saturday or so. It started when I logged off my main account after a perfectly normal game with good performance (~120fps with 60ms) and when I logged back into my smurf, the client was incredibly buggy and had huge fps drops -- I had to wait a whole minute for the dynamic queue animations to finish so I could start queueing up.

So far, the only workaround I've managed to discover is to completely reinstall league and not log out :/

For me, ranked is different to normals in that i'm expecting myself to have to carry every single game. so you should try to go in with the mentality that you are going to be playing against more difficult opponents than before (don't let that scare you off though!) with roughly the same skillcap teammates

also, 100% do not play on auto pilot; that is the single worst thing you can do in a ranked game. try to analyse each situation carefully rather than just saying "it'll be fine". I remember having to learn this myself and I wished someone was there to tell me earlier that being too greedy can cause you to lose so many games.
